title: Transition Pressure
purpose: Show how pressure, coherence and correction interact during a bounded transition.
output_interpretation: Returns a time series, final band, instability events and practical reading.
limits: The result is a bounded public demonstrator reading, not a proof and not external client evidence.
Proof and retirement status come from the public evidence graph, not from numeric simulation output.
